summary.answer: Creates a controller-owned full-screen KillcamMenu_WZ, initializes killcamAllowRespawn only if unset, requests menu-open sound and constructs the displayed deathcam children/assets. Registers Killcam state from the visibility bit. Its close wrapper stops the one-shot sound then requests team_eliminated music; scriptNotify callback plays EndTransition only for post_killcam_transition. Processes menu_loaded, registers class close hook, optionally calls PostLoadFunc, writes ignoreCursor and starts the one-shot sound before returning self. All hooks/subscriptions remain deferred; no respawn/network transaction is proved.

summary.answer: ui/main common death-menu path constructs DownButNotOut conditionally through engine UI handling (caller trace retained). Builds DBNO decorative/text/crosshair-occluding children. WarzoneGlobal.collapse and waveRespawnTimer nonnil values setup respective end timers without partial seconds. WaveSpawn state is wzEnableWaveRespawn==1; effective HMH value is not invented. Before original close, StopPlayOnceSound clears/stops uin_killcam_oneshot_for_duck; menu_loaded is processed, linked __onClose hook installed, optional postload runs, ignoreCursor set, PlaySoundOnce starts marker/audio, PlayClipAndThenClose(DefaultClip) schedules closure, then returns self. Timer completion, close dispatcher and sound playback are external. Full class clips/close outside selected span remain exact source dependencies, not reconstructed.
